info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Callbacks API

params.name: orgId
params.description: The organization ID for which the callback is being scheduled. This should be a valid UUID.

params.name: callbackNumber
params.description: The callback customer number to filter the scheduled callbacks. Only an exact match will yield the result. Allows an optional country code followed by digits (0-9) and the special characters: space, hyphen -, parentheses ( and ), and period ., ensuring the total length is between 7 and 15 characters.

params.name: assigneeAgent
params.description: The unique identifier of the agent assigned to handle the callback. Must be in UUID format. This parameter is optional, but at least one of assigneeAgent or callbackNumber must be provided.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the results by. If `sortBy` is set to `assignedTime`, the `assigneeAgent` parameter must also be provided.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The order to sort the results in.

items.docs: Allows the user to list scheduled callbacks for a given customer number or assignee agent, excluding those whose scheduled trigger time has already passed. Requires 'cjp:user' scope for authorization.

items.docs: Creates a new callback request for a customer. Authorization requires the cjp:user scope. The callback default endpoint (EP) and default ANI must be configured as mandatory settings to successfully make API calls.
